correctness.rationale: The frozen RESULT.md defines loop-free ordered-edge Bernoulli frames and the global all-valuations axiom Diamond Box q -> Box Diamond q. Its first-order correspondence quantifies all x,y,z including y=z. For each unordered distinct u,v the no-common-out-neighbor probability is (1-p²)^(n-2). For any fixed k distinct pairs the common-target joint probability is (1+o(1))n^(-2k)e^(-kt), including shared-endpoint configurations (np³,np⁴->0); factorial moments give Poisson(e^(-t)/2). The direct pair-overlap expectation O(n^(-1)), no-common-predecessor expectation O(n^(-2)), and min-outdegree Chernoff estimate jointly establish the needed good event. On that event each bad pair is activated by an old predecessor; disjoint tails force K>=Z. Inserting u->w for any old successor w of v different from u repairs each missing pair without destroying any prior out-neighbor intersection, giving K<=Z. Exactly one insertion with tail in each bad pair and head an old successor of the opposite vertex gives the multiplicity product d+(u)+d+(v)-1_(u->v)-1_(v->u); bounded K and uniform degree concentration yield H/(2np)^K->1 and conditional fixed-k statements. Inspected verification script enumerates direct modal semantics and small optimal edits; finite checks corroborate, not prove, asymptotics.
